message.content:
I bought this second-hand mechanical keyboard for $38 because I wanted real switches without boutique prices. The seller was friendly, but when I asked what switches it had, the answer came a week later—after I’d already paid. By then it was less customer service than historical footnote.

The board is not perfect. The space bar rattles like a small shopping cart with a bad wheel, and one key—the E, of course—will occasionally repeat itself. I’ve learned to backspace with dignity. Still, the typing feel is soft in a good way, and I’ve written long emails on it without wrist complaints. It isn’t quiet or flawless or collector-grade.

I considered shipping it back. For $38 and a little patience, though, it does what I need. If you want pristine, look elsewhere. If you want a comfortable, slightly haunted daily typer, this is fine. I kept it. Three out of five.
